name: pi-context
description: A /context command for pi that shows what's consuming your context window — tool schemas grouped by extension, system prompt, context files, skills, and conversation.
author: Eric Boehs

scripts.//: Nothing is declared as a dependency: pi's git installer runs a plain `npm install` in the clone, and npm installs a root package's devDependencies and non-optional peers — which dropped a 200MB copy of pi into ~/.pi/agent/git for a package that ships one .ts file and bundles nothing. The types are fetched on demand instead, by CI and by anyone typechecking locally: npm install --no-save typescript@5 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent @earendil-works/pi-tui typebox. That install cannot live in the script below, because npm run's nested install reifies the tree against this manifest and prunes what it just added.
